# Craft Cutting Machines: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation. Re-verify links and contents when updating this skill; these
help centers reorganize often and some block automated fetching, so open them in a browser.

Last verified: 2026-10-30

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Cricut

- Change or reset the Cricut account password (one Cricut ID for cricut.com and Design Space):
  https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009379294-How-do-I-change-or-reset-my-Cricut-account-password
- Bluetooth and USB connection guide (pairing PIN on older machines only):
  https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/6581830148759
- Updating machine firmware through Design Space: https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009427514
- Example of an automatically delivered firmware fix (Explore 3 and Maker 3, 2025):
  https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/35531751922583
- System requirements and unsupported platforms: https://help.cricut.com/hc/articles/360009556033
- Design Space FAQ (offline feature by platform): https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009503353-Design-Space-FAQ
- Sharing and making projects private; uploaded-image canvases kept private:
  https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009377574 and
  https://help.cricut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009381714
- 2017 checkout card-skimming notice for the Cricut online shop (Provo Craft letter, filed with the
  California Attorney General): https://oag.ca.gov/system/files/Provo%20Craft%20Consumer%20Notification%20Letter_2.pdf

### Silhouette

- Legal, privacy policy, and terms (card tokenization, account cancellation effects, licence keys, cloud
  storage by membership, machine and software data): https://www.silhouetteamerica.com/legal#privacy-policy

### Brother ScanNCut

- CanvasWorkspace notice (web version discontinued; PC version, ScanNCut Link, and Artspira share an
  account; data migration): https://support.canvasworkspace.brother.com/cwsinfo/top/en.html
- CanvasWorkspace: https://canvasworkspace.brother.com/en
- ScanNCut wireless network setup guide (2.4 GHz, no WPA/WPA2 Enterprise, machine registration with a
  machine number and PIN): https://download.brother.com/welcome/doch101468/snc3_wnsg04en.pdf

### Desktop lasers (example)

- Glowforge first print (start by pressing the button on the machine):
  https://support.glowforge.com/hc/en-us/articles/17395725153691-your-first-glowforge-craft-series-print

None of these vendors published a dedicated security-advisory page for these products at last review.
Check each vendor's help center and announcements for current issues.

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.
